memory_candidates.content: This shell's `grep` is a ugrep shim invoked with `--ignore-files`, which silently honors `.gitignore` and omits gitignored trees (e.g. `.claude/**` deployed copies) from repo-wide searches. Any survivor/dangling-reference accounting that must include gitignored trees needs `command grep` (bypasses shell functions/aliases) rather than bare `grep`.

When a plan supplies example replacement wording for a deletion, check whether the wording itself contains the string the same phase's verification grep checks for zero occurrences of. A rationale note like 'X information lives in...' can literally re-embed the string 'X' it is trying to eliminate, causing the phase's own acceptance check to fail against the plan's own suggested text.
